vectors.name: valid-empty
vectors.description: A prepared spool holding no committed record.

vectors.name: valid-minimal
vectors.description: One committed data transaction, no session end.

vectors.name: valid-complete
vectors.description: Data, a checkpoint, and a clean session end.

vectors.name: valid-checkpoint-sync
vectors.description: The same session under checkpoint sync: the durable extent stops at the checkpoint.

vectors.name: valid-buffered
vectors.description: The same session under buffered writes: nothing is claimed as durable.

vectors.name: valid-unknown-minor
vectors.description: A future minor version using only defined record kinds; readable.

vectors.name: valid-aborted-with-losses
vectors.description: A legally incomplete session: the counters and first positions record the losses.

vectors.name: valid-fault-record
vectors.description: A faulted capture with a committed fault record.

vectors.name: valid-aborted-then-faulted
vectors.description: An abort escalated to faulted by a recorder fault during the drain: request and outcome differ.

vectors.name: torn-inside-body
vectors.description: The last transaction was cut in half by a crash.

vectors.name: torn-missing-trailer
vectors.description: Records landed; the commit trailer did not.

vectors.name: torn-inside-record-header
vectors.description: The file ends part way through a record header.

vectors.name: torn-superblock
vectors.description: The file is shorter than the fixed superblock.

vectors.name: torn-plan-document
vectors.description: The superblock survived; the plan document did not.

vectors.name: corrupt-magic
vectors.description: The file does not begin with the spool magic.

vectors.name: corrupt-superblock-checksum
vectors.description: A flipped superblock byte, detected by the superblock checksum.

vectors.name: corrupt-plan-document
vectors.description: The stored plan no longer hashes to the recorded plan fingerprint.

vectors.name: nonzero-plan-padding
vectors.description: A nonzero byte in the unchecksummed gap behind the plan document.

vectors.name: unknown-major-version
vectors.description: A container major version this reader refuses.

vectors.name: undefined-superblock-field
vectors.description: A checksum algorithm identifier version 1 does not define.

vectors.name: corrupt-record-payload
vectors.description: A flipped payload byte, detected by the record checksum.

vectors.name: corrupt-record-header
vectors.description: A flipped record header byte, detected by the record header checksum.

vectors.name: corrupt-body-checksum
vectors.description: A resealed trailer whose body checksum no longer matches the body.

vectors.name: corrupt-trailer-checksum
vectors.description: A flipped trailer byte, detected by the trailer checksum.

vectors.name: corrupt-transaction-header-checksum
vectors.description: A flipped transaction header byte, detected by its checksum.

vectors.name: nonzero-padding
vectors.description: Record padding that carries something.

vectors.name: duplicate-transaction-id
vectors.description: The same transaction id committed twice.

vectors.name: transaction-id-gap
vectors.description: A transaction id that skips its predecessor.

vectors.name: bad-back-link
vectors.description: A back link that does not name the previous transaction.

vectors.name: record-count-disagreement
vectors.description: Header and trailer disagree on how many records were committed.

vectors.name: empty-transaction
vectors.description: A transaction that commits nothing.

vectors.name: trailer-item-counts
vectors.description: A trailer claiming more data items than the transaction carries.

vectors.name: unknown-record-kind
vectors.description: A committed record kind this version cannot name.

vectors.name: records-after-session-end
vectors.description: A transaction committed after the session had ended.

vectors.name: session-end-without-accounting
vectors.description: A session end that seals no accounting snapshot.

vectors.name: accounting-with-items
vectors.description: An accounting snapshot sharing its transaction with a data item.

vectors.name: accounting-identity-violation
vectors.description: Counters that do not satisfy the per-handoff identities.

vectors.name: accounting-uint64-wraparound
vectors.description: Counters that satisfy the identities only after unsigned 64-bit wraparound.

vectors.name: accounting-exceeds-prefix
vectors.description: Self-consistent counters claiming more than the committed prefix holds.

vectors.name: accounting-origin-not-recorder
vectors.description: Spool accounting claiming an origin only a finalizer could have.

vectors.name: checkpoint-extent-beyond-transaction
vectors.description: A checkpoint claiming more synced bytes than existed when it was written.

vectors.name: container-payload-size
vectors.description: A container-owned record whose payload is not its fixed size.

vectors.name: ordinal-block-mismatch
vectors.description: A signal_block whose logical_ordinal is not its owning frame's.

vectors.name: ordinal-gap-mismatch
vectors.description: A signal_gap whose logical_ordinal is not its owning discontinuity's.

vectors.name: ordinal-session-end-nonzero
vectors.description: A record with no owning item that carries a nonzero logical_ordinal.

vectors.name: record-flags-nonzero
vectors.description: A record or trailer whose flags field is not the version-1 zero.

vectors.name: session-end-undefined-outcome
vectors.description: A session_end whose capture_outcome is not a defined value.

vectors.name: checkpoint-policy-mismatch
vectors.description: A checkpoint whose durability policy is not the superblock's.

vectors.name: accounting-flag-invalid
vectors.description: An accounting flag byte that is neither 0 nor 1.

vectors.name: accounting-position-tag-invalid
vectors.description: An accounting position whose tag is not 0, 1, or 2.

vectors.name: accounting-position-consistency
vectors.description: A first-loss position present while its loss counter is zero.

vectors.name: multiple-accounting
vectors.description: Two accounting snapshots committed; the summary is written once.

vectors.name: multiple-session-end
vectors.description: Two session_end records committed; a session has one outcome.

vectors.name: accounting-without-session-end
vectors.description: An accounting snapshot committed with no session_end to seal it.

vectors.name: corrupt-tail-wrong-magic
vectors.description: A complete header with the wrong begin magic: corruption, not truncation.

vectors.name: corrupt-tail-bad-header-bytes
vectors.description: A checksum-valid header whose header_bytes is not 48.

vectors.name: accounting-position-loss-missing
vectors.description: An accepted-item loss with no first-loss ordinal latched.

vectors.name: accounting-position-data-loss-tag
vectors.description: A first data loss recorded as a producer identity, not an ordinal.

vectors.name: accounting-position-data-rejection-tag
vectors.description: A first data rejection recorded as an ordinal, not a producer identity.

vectors.name: accounting-position-control-loss-tag
vectors.description: A first control loss recorded as a producer identity, not an ordinal.

vectors.name: accounting-position-control-rejection-tag
vectors.description: A first control rejection recorded as an ordinal, not a producer identity.

vectors.name: accounting-position-identity-kind-unknown
vectors.description: A first rejection whose identity_kind is not in the registry.

vectors.name: accounting-position-identity-kind-wrong-plane
vectors.description: A first data rejection that names a control record-set kind.
